name: GPU-based Mesh Decimation via Edge Collapse
aliases: GPU-based Mesh Decimation with Quadric Error Metrics
Mesh Decimation using QEM Edge Collapse
definition: A mesh simplification technique that reduces vertex count by iteratively collapsing edges, implemented on GPU using Thrust and CUDA kernels. It supports only triangular faces.
summary: GPU-based Mesh Decimation via Edge Collapse is a CUDA algorithm that reduces mesh vertex count by collapsing edges using Quadric Error Metrics, distinguished by its fixed two-iteration approach for speed and stability.
